name: CyberAlchemy Ontology Product
purpose: Turn owner-selected source meaning into durable, typed, source-bound ontology packages that people and machines can validate, inspect, retrieve, evolve, and replace without transferring meaning authority to the Product or runtime.

excludes: Publication, release, deployment, or source retirement

claim_ceiling: Private test-candidate Product identity and contract only. It does not admit the Product, prove user value, own source meaning, adopt the runtime, admit contexts, approve the Product, or authorize publication, release, deployment, or source retirement.
